entries.actual: Production SHA 6f7191f0f5e59153541271ea291f3727015f5741 reports livez=200 and readyz=200 but healthz=503 with 39/40 and 61 violations. The exact candidate passes 40/40 and rollback in isolated Postgres, Release gate, CodeQL and a Vercel preview build, but production DDL, DATABASE_URL principal membership, managed recovery and promotion were not exercised.
repair_attempts: Confirmed the database connection path independently recovered and the transaction pooler is detected.
Read the production catalogs without mutation and reduced the health failure to one missing relation, two missing roles, 29 non-forced relations and 29 legacy grants.
Reproduced the exact 61-violation signature, reached 40/40 and restored the failing baseline in an isolated PostgreSQL 16 container.
Published an exact-SHA preview and attempted authenticated preview fetch through the Vercel connector; deployment authorization was unavailable.
entries.strategy_reset: Quarantine only the managed production mutation and protected-canary cone; preserve fail-closed production behavior and the verified candidate.
quarantine_scope: deployed DATABASE_URL principal membership or credential change
deferred_external_infra: Supabase project cfwkqhenhnvnnwpxdjns production owner and recovery window
Vercel project prj_hEQQeozR9ZfauHr1QWvxZiZ3A9pQ release owner and deployment access
remaining_uncertainty: Local dump/restore proves migration reversibility in a production-like shape, not managed PITR readiness or the deployed login principal's compatibility.
A READY deployment badge does not prove preview health, production health or canonical catalog state.
entries.next_action: A named database and release owner follows docs/runbooks/A01_PRODUCTION_READINESS_GATE.md and records the managed restore point, migration receipt, principal membership, exact deployment ID and post-promotion readbacks.

entries.symptom: Production readyz intermittently returned 503 even though healthz could still query the canonical database.
entries.expected: The dependency-readiness SELECT 1 probe remains stable through the configured Supavisor transaction pooler.
entries.actual: Managed PostgreSQL logs at 2026-09-02T07:16:56.418Z and 2026-09-02T07:20:53.675Z reported prepared statement readiness-v1 already exists. The old production route sent a client-named node-postgres statement through a pooled backend whose prepared-statement state the serverless process did not own.
repair_attempts: Correlated the bounded readyz failure timestamps with managed PostgreSQL logs.
Removed the client-provided prepared-statement name while retaining the exact SELECT 1 dependency probe.
Added a test-sensitive assertion that the route uses an unnamed query and cannot reintroduce readiness-v1.
Ran typecheck, lint, 225/225 tests, production build, GitHub Release gate and CodeQL at the exact candidate SHA.
quarantine_scope: production dependency-readiness finality until the exact candidate is canary-proven and promoted
deferred_external_infra: Vercel protected preview canary
exact-SHA production promotion
remaining_uncertainty: The code defect is locally and independently repaired, but production remains on the old SHA and can still reproduce it.
entries.next_action: After the managed recovery and Vercel access gates pass, canary and promote exact candidate 0d4fa2587b85f6cd50db7f713bf919d6bc7f8f6a, then prove repeated readyz=200 through the production pooler.

entries.symptom: The first exact-head Release gate failed one of 343 tests because the CORE-02 freeze proof tried to resolve the stacked PR base commit from GitHub's shallow merge checkout.
entries.expected: The contract and SDK freeze proof runs in local and shallow PR checkouts while still failing on any checked-out tree drift from the immutable CORE-01 release trees.
entries.actual: Release gate 33937410404 checked out merge ref 5ba0d36962d6628aa75860cc5e585cbefb3be88e without base object bb5eb395af0873f4483ba2dc10c76f9941051dde; git rev-parse of the base path failed before the checked-out-tree equality assertions ran. The inventory and 342 other tests passed.
repair_attempts: Kept the exact base SHA and the two immutable tree IDs pinned in the manifest and test.
Removed only the assumption that a shallow PR checkout retains the base commit object.
Compared the checked-out HEAD contract and SDK trees to the immutable tree IDs derived from the exact CORE-01 final.
Reran focused 6/6, full 343/343, compliance, typecheck, lint, build, Release gate 33937609720 and CodeQL 33937609688 successfully at c9e11c4d2ceb062678b3146ba6e8601ba7846761.
remaining_uncertainty: The test proves immutable repository tree identity, not an authenticated deployed application boundary.
entries.next_action: Retain both the failed first-head and successful repaired-head CI records as append-only evidence; no further repair is required.

entries.symptom: The first focused run passed 16/19 but rejected the valid current training fixture, failed the contradictory-training sensitivity assertion and classified manifest pin drift as a generic value error; TypeScript also rejected a string-to-number clock comparison.
entries.expected: Training currency is derived from parsed epoch milliseconds against the explicit assessment clock, contradictory status fails, and immutable manifest pin drift returns the manifest-drift class.
entries.actual: The initial parser compared an ISO string directly to a numeric assessment epoch and reused the generic literal helper for frozen manifest pins.
repair_attempts: Parsed the training expiry timestamp before comparing it to the deterministic assessment epoch.
Added manifest-specific immutable-pin comparison so pin drift retains OPS_MANIFEST_DRIFT.
Reran focused 19/19 and TypeScript successfully.
entries.next_action: Retain deterministic explicit-clock fixtures in every consumer implementation.

entries.symptom: The first lint pass reported one unused evidence-loop index warning.
entries.expected: ESLint passes with zero warnings.
entries.actual: The parser enumerated evidence refs with an unused index after error messages were simplified.
repair_attempts: Iterated directly over evidence refs without the unused index.
Reran lint with zero warnings and the complete local release gate successfully.
entries.next_action: No further repair is required.

entries.symptom: The authoritative CORE assurance audit classified the prior candidate NOT_CLEARED because internal projections were not exact-opt-in or globally/tenant/source bounded, journey maps omitted reverse edges including GJ-1/U008, the secret scan omitted dedicated evidence files and standard token classes, and the handoff model could not bind its own exact final SHA.
entries.expected: Every internal write is exact-opt-in behind the global mutation gate and bounded admission, every journey edge is bidirectional, every declared evidence byte receives standard credential scanning, and exact-final evidence is detached from the commit it attests.
entries.actual: SUPPORT-CORE-ASSURE-01/v1 fingerprint 3fdc9ddf470509ec9c115656a431f414b9796dda14ec0aaaf9133fbaab796968 recorded zero cleared, fifteen partial, nine unknown and one failed assurance row.
repair_attempts: Changed internal projection request semantics to exact true and required the exact global mutation gate, configured database/service authentication and non-empty tenant/source admission.
Bound the Shopify projection POST to the authenticated tenant and fixed SHOPIFY source through exact allowlists while retaining the default-off environment example.
Made route, relation-group, job and unknown journey maps mechanically equal in both directions and restored GJ-1/U008.
Declared and scanned all fifteen dedicated CORE-02 evidence paths across standard credential/token classes and specified a post-final content-addressed tag attestation.
deferred_external_infra: signed owner returns for nineteen unknowns
authenticated application readback
managed recovery and every G1/G2 decision
remaining_uncertainty: The repository correction does not clear the fifteen partial or nine unknown controller rows that require consumer, owner, deployed or recovery evidence.
All seven owner packets remain unsigned and all nineteen answers remain UNKNOWN.
entries.next_action: Retain the exact no-effect correction and admit no owner answer without a verifiable human signature and immutable evidence.

All three disposable proofs passed and scheduled container cleanup.

Retained the reverse guard so rollback with v2 data remains fail-closed.
remaining_uncertainty: A managed rollback decision would still require explicit G2 authority and data-preservation planning.
entries.next_action: Preserve the pre-activation-only reverse contract and never represent it as a production rollback authorization.

Derived and enforced the same server-owned deadline without invoking a mutation or adapter.
Reran focused and disposable replay/conflict proof successfully.

Reran the complete disposable proof successfully with the runtime role still lacking UPDATE privilege.
